record.paper_title: Gradings, Braidings, Representations, Paraparticles: Some Open Problems
record.original_question: For the graded and braided paraparticle Hopf structures arising from small finite abelian group gradings and compatible braidings of the mixed paraparticle algebras P_BF and P_FB, can bosonization or bosonization-like methods be applied or developed to produce ordinary Hopf structures with no grading and trivial braiding while preserving equivalent representation theories?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $B$ and $F$ denote, respectively, the algebra of $N$ pairs of paraboson creation/annihilation generators (satisfying the Green triple relations of parabosonic type) and the algebra of $M$ pairs of parafermion creation/annihilation generators (satisfying the Green triple relations of parafermionic type). Form the two mixed paraparticle algebras $P_{BF}$ and $P_{FB}$ obtained by combining $B$ and $F$ via the two inequivalent families of relative (anti)commutation relations between paraboson and parafermion generators. Each of $P_{BF}$ and $P_{FB}$ carries a family of Hopf algebra structures in the braided monoidal category ${}^{G}_{G}\mathcal{YD}$ of Yetter–Drinfeld modules over a finite abelian group $G$, where the $G$-grading on the generators and the corresponding bicharacter $\chi: G\times G \to k^\times$ (determining the braiding) are chosen so that the defining relations of $P_{BF}$ (respectively $P_{FB}$) are homogeneous and compatible with $\chi$.
 
Problem: For every choice of finite abelian group $G$ and bicharacter $\chi$ making $P_{BF}$ (respectively $P_{FB}$) into a braided Hopf algebra in ${}^{G}_{G}\mathcal{YD}$, develop a bosonization (Radford–Majid biproduct) or analogous procedure that produces an ordinary (ungraded, symmetrically braided) Hopf algebra $\widehat{H}$ over $k$ such that the categories of representations of the braided Hopf algebra and of $\widehat{H}$ are equivalent (as suitable monoidal categories), thereby reducing the braided representation theory of $P_{BF}$ and $P_{FB}$ to the representation theory of ordinary Hopf algebras. Determine explicitly such $\widehat{H}$ and the equivalence, or prove obstructions to its existence.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open research objective concerning bosonization-type constructions for braided Hopf structures on mixed paraboson–parafermion algebras. While Radford–Majid bosonization is a standard tool for braided Hopf algebras in Yetter–Drinfeld categories over finite abelian groups, no published work was located that carries this out for the mixed paraparticle algebras $P_{BF}$ and $P_{FB}$ in the generality stated, and the problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Gradings, Braidings, Representations, Paraparticles: Some Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Lists open research objectives on graded/braided Hopf structures of paraparticle algebras, including bosonization.
status_evidence.claim: The bosonization question for braided paraparticle Hopf structures is listed as an open research objective.
